name: sub_reset_thunk
comment: CLC / XCE / JMP $80:8000 - enters native mode and jumps to the FastROM mirror

name: sub_nmi
comment: native NMI vector target; not yet analysed

name: dat_cart_header_ext
comment: extended header: maker code 01, game code CG

name: dat_cart_header
comment: title, map mode $30, cart type $02, checksum $EEAE

name: tbl_vectors
comment: native + emulation vector tables; only NMI and emulation RESET are used

name: ram_course_number
comment: course number; hole index = course*8 + hole

name: ram_hole_in_course
comment: hole 0-7 within the course

name: ram_course_shape
comment: course grid layer 1: terrain shape id $00-$1B per cell; $00 = gap

name: ram_course_height
comment: course grid layer 3: elevation $00-$0F per cell

name: ram_course_flags
comment: course grid layer 4: low nibble = wall flag per cell edge, N/E/S/W

name: ram_course_content
comment: course grid layer 2: object id per cell, looked up in $82:BDBC at load

name: ram_course_header
comment: the 28-byte hole header; +2 = grid width, +4 = grid height

name: ram_hole_index3
comment: hole index * 3; the index into every bank $88 course table

name: ram_probe_shape
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: terrain shape under the active object

name: ram_probe_height
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: elevation of that cell

name: ram_probe_ground_z
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: 32-bit surface Z at the exact position

name: ram_probe_tile
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: layer-2 special-tile byte under the object

name: ram_bounce_damp_xy
comment: Q15 factor applied to vx and vy on each bounce; friction tiles rewrite it

name: ram_bounce_damp_z
comment: Q15 factor applied to vz on each bounce

name: sub_init
comment: console init; entered via the RESET thunk. STZ $4200 / REP #$30 / MVN $00,$00 / TXS

name: sub_dma_cgram
comment: DMA the $7E:0400 CGRAM staging buffer to $2122; mode $22, count from tbl_cgram_dma

name: tbl_cgram_dma
comment: 3 sets of (size, source, CGADD) for sub_dma_cgram, indexed by $00A0 * 8

name: sub_vram_queue
comment: queue 8-byte VRAM transfer records (terminated by $FFFF) into the ring at $7E:0200

name: sub_vram_enqueue_one
comment: copy one 8-byte record into the $7E:0200 ring, or DMA it directly when $7D is negative

name: tbl_edge_bitmask
comment: 01 02 04 08 10 20 40 80; entries 0-3 mask the layer-4 wall bits for N/E/S/W

name: sub_oam_reset_ptrs
comment: set OAM buffer pointers ($2C=$0600 low, $2E/$32=$0800 high) and zero the 10 queue counts

name: sub_oam_enqueue
comment: dispatch on $7E:2880 to one of 10 OAM priority queues; A=X pos, X=Y pos, Y=frame ptr

name: sub_oam_build
comment: drain all 10 priority queues into the OAM staging buffer at $7E:0600

name: sub_oam_emit_frame
comment: walk a 5-byte metasprite part list, emit hardware sprites. See docs/graphics.md

name: sub_oam_emit_frame_alt
comment: second copy of sub_oam_emit_frame for the other queue set; same record format

name: sub_obj_set_frame_ptr
comment: store a frame list pointer into $7E:0B9E,X (addr) and $7E:0BBE,X (bank)

name: sub_obj_draw
comment: look up the current frame from the object's list and enqueue it if on screen

name: sub_hal_decompress
comment: HAL LZ decompressor. A=src bank, X=src addr, Y=dest addr, DBR=dest bank. JSL/RTL

name: sub_decompress_queue
comment: queue an asset for the resumable decompressor; writes the $7E:531C..$579C arrays

name: sub_hal_decompress_resume
comment: resumable variant of sub_hal_decompress; state in DP $AB/$AD/$AF, $B1 bytes per call

name: sub_spc_ipl_upload
comment: SPC700 IPL boot handshake; uploads the driver from tbl_spc_ipl_blocks

name: tbl_spc_ipl_blocks
comment: one block: len $0A0B -> SPC $0800, then a $0000 terminator whose addr is the entry point

name: dat_spc_driver
comment: N-SPC driver image, loaded to SPC $0800. Contains the string *Ver S1.20* at +$092D

name: sub_spc_play_song
comment: write a song id to APU port 0; ids below $7E are ignored, $7E+ uploads first

name: sub_spc_command
comment: write a command byte to APU port 0 without the upload path

name: sub_spc_sfx_trigger
comment: allocate an SFX channel from tbl_sfx_slots / tbl_sfx_priority and signal port 1

name: sub_spc_reset_state
comment: clear the driver's SNES-side mirror at $1004-$1012

name: sub_spc_set_volume
comment: store a master volume to $1003 and APU port 2

name: sub_spc_upload_set
comment: upload an init set (samples / directory / instruments) via tbl_spc_init_sets

name: sub_spc_upload_song
comment: upload one song's block chain from tbl_spc_songs to SPC $6502

name: sub_spc_send_block
comment: byte-stream one block chain to the APU through ports 0 and 2

name: tbl_spc_init_sets
comment: 2 entries; each points to a zero-terminated list of long pointers to block chains

name: tbl_spc_songs
comment: 33 songs x (addr16, bank16); song id = $7E + index

name: tbl_sfx_slots
comment: per-SFX channel-allocation mask used by sub_spc_sfx_trigger

name: tbl_sfx_id
comment: per-SFX id byte compared against the active-channel state at $1008

name: tbl_sfx_priority
comment: per-SFX priority stored to $100E when a channel is claimed

name: sub_course_enter
comment: course entry: load graphics sets and tilesets, then JSL sub_course_load_bg

name: sub_load_asset
comment: decompress a stream to $7F:0000 (bank pushed as $7E7F); A=bank X=addr Y=dest

name: sub_load_asset_vram
comment: as sub_load_asset to $7F:0000, then pass the Y parameter block to sub_vram_queue

name: sub_load_gfx_set_a
comment: jump table of 8 graphics loaders; entry 0 runs on course entry

name: sub_load_gfx_set_b
comment: jump table of 6 graphics loaders

name: sub_load_tileset
comment: jump table of 28 tileset loaders; entry 0 loads the course tiles to VRAM $6000

name: dat_gravity
comment: $FFC0 (-64), added to the ball's vz every frame by $81:899F

name: dat_bounce_min_frames
comment: $0010; below this many frames since the last bounce the ball comes to rest

name: dat_bounce_damp_xy
comment: $5332 (Q15 0.65); default vx/vy factor per bounce, copied to $7E:DA3C

name: dat_bounce_damp_z
comment: $6665 (Q15 0.80); default vz factor per bounce, copied to $7E:DA3E

name: tbl_tile_friction
comment: coefficients the $20-$24 friction tiles write into $DA3A/$DA3C/$DA3E

name: tbl_kicker_clamp
comment: impulse clamp for the $10-$13 kicker tiles

name: tbl_tile_impulse
comment: impulse magnitudes for the $70-$7B toggled tiles

name: sub_ball_physics_step
comment: JSL; one frame of ball physics for the object selected by $7E:180B

name: sub_tile_land
comment: dispatch the layer-2 byte in A through tbl_tile_on_land

name: tbl_tile_on_land
comment: 256 long pointers, indexed by the layer-2 byte; behaviour on landing

name: sub_tile_hit
comment: dispatch the layer-2 byte in A through tbl_tile_on_hit

name: tbl_tile_on_hit
comment: 256 long pointers; behaviour when the ball hits the cell from the side

name: sub_tile_none_land
comment: default on-land handler, 112 of the 256 tile values

name: sub_damp_velocities
comment: vx,vy *= $7E:DA3C and vz *= $7E:DA3E via sub_mul_fixed_signed

name: sub_check_fell_out
comment: world Z < -$110000: set $7E:D9D2 bit 0 and zero all three velocities

name: sub_tile_none_hit
comment: default on-hit handler, the same 112 values

name: sub_edge_step_height
comment: surface step across a cell edge: 2*elevation + tbl_terrain_edge_h[shape*4+dir]

name: sub_edge_wall_flags
comment: the only read of course grid layer 4; masks its low nibble by direction 0-3

name: tbl_terrain_edge_h
comment: 28 shapes x 4 bytes: surface level at the N/E/S/W edge midpoint, in half steps

name: sub_terrain_probe
comment: JSL; world position -> cell index, shape, elevation, quadrant, 32-bit surface Z

name: tbl_surface_handler
comment: 5 targets for JMP ($952A,X): flat, then ramps rising with +y, -x, -y, +x

name: tbl_terrain_quad_diag
comment: per-quadrant Z for shapes $10-$1B; $FFFF means evaluate a diagonal ramp

name: tbl_surface_handler_diag
comment: 9 targets for the diagonal surface codes; 1-4 are unreachable traps

name: tbl_shape_handler_idx
comment: surface shape code 0-8 -> tbl_surface_handler index; $FF for the diagonals

name: tbl_terrain_diag_bias
comment: Z bias subtracted for shapes $10-$1B; $5A82 for $14-$17, else $0000

name: tbl_terrain_quad
comment: 28 shapes x 4 words: surface shape code per quadrant, quadrant order N/E/S/W

name: sub_tile_surface_overlay
comment: tiles $60-$6F; tracks entering and leaving in $69CA/$69D2-$69DA

name: sub_tile_actor_land
comment: tiles $40-$52 and $57; the per-hole actors

name: sub_tile_friction
comment: tiles $20-$24; overwrite the bounce coefficients

name: sub_tile_edge
comment: tiles $28-$2D; falls through to sub_apply_gravity

name: sub_tile_tall_object
comment: tile $02; a solid standing 3 height steps above the cell

name: sub_tile_hazard
comment: tiles $80-$8F and $98-$A1; calls $83:ABC5 like falling out of the world

name: tbl_boost_delta
comment: +512 / -512, the velocity deltas the $30-$3B boost panels add

name: sub_tile_kicker
comment: tiles $10-$13; landing vz becomes a directional vx/vy impulse

name: sub_find_marked_cell
comment: scan layer 2 for $0C or $C3; records column, row and elevation+1

name: sub_set_hole_index
comment: hole index = $6A5A*8 + $6A5E; writes it, *2 and *3 to $ABB2/$ABB4/$ABB6

name: sub_course_load_bg
comment: decompress course tables 5-7 and the two tilemaps (8, 9) for the hole in $7E:ABB6

name: sub_course_load_header
comment: copy the 28-byte uncompressed hole header from tbl_course_header to $7E:8B90

name: sub_course_load_grids
comment: decompress course tables 1-4 (w*h grid layers) and table 10

name: sub_spawn_course_actors
comment: load-time sweep of layer 2; looks each value up in tbl_tile_actor

name: tbl_tile_actor
comment: 256 words, layer-2 byte -> actor id; $FFFF means no actor

name: sub_ball_lost
comment: consequence of a hazard tile or of falling out of the world; not traced

name: tbl_height_z_lo
comment: Z(h) = h * $5A82, low words, indexed by elevation*2

name: tbl_height_z_hi
comment: Z(h) = h * $5A82, high words, indexed by elevation*2

name: tbl_slope_ramp
comment: 1024-entry linear ramp 22..46316; 0-511 spans one height step, 0-1023 two

name: tbl_course_header
comment: 256 long pointers to 28-byte uncompressed hole headers (8 words + 12-char name)

name: tbl_course_grid1
comment: 256 long pointers; w*h grid layer -> $7E:6B90 (size = header word 0)

name: tbl_course_grid2
comment: 256 long pointers; w*h grid layer -> $7E:8390 (size = header word 0)

name: tbl_course_grid3
comment: 256 long pointers; w*h grid layer -> $7E:7390 (size = header word 0)

name: tbl_course_grid4
comment: 256 long pointers; w*h grid layer -> $7E:7B90 (size = header word 0)

name: tbl_course_tab5
comment: 256 long pointers; ~114-byte 16-bit table -> $7E:93B0

name: tbl_course_tab6
comment: 256 long pointers; ~114-byte 16-bit table -> $7E:9BB0

name: tbl_course_tab7
comment: 256 long pointers; ~114-byte 16-bit table -> $7E:8BB0

name: tbl_course_bg1
comment: 256 long pointers; course tilemap -> $7F:3000

name: tbl_course_bg2
comment: 256 long pointers; course tilemap -> $7F:9800

name: tbl_course_tab10
comment: 256 long pointers; ~150-byte 16-bit table -> $7E:A3B2

name: tbl_sprite_frames
comment: 105 word pointers into bank $89 to metasprite part lists; $FFFF = unused

name: gfx_course_terrain
comment: HAL stream -> 18944 bytes at $7F:2000; isometric course terrain tiles

name: gfx_title_e000
comment: HAL stream -> 6848 bytes at $7F:E000; title screen tiles

name: gfx_course_hud
comment: HAL stream -> 13312 bytes to VRAM $6000; font and HUD tiles

name: gfx_title_7800
comment: HAL stream -> 6656 bytes at $7F:7800; title screen tiles

name: gfx_title_1fc0
comment: HAL stream -> 4160 bytes at $7F:1FC0; title screen tiles

name: gfx_course_vram0
comment: HAL stream -> 8192 bytes to VRAM $0000

name: dat_brr_samples
comment: BRR sample block -> SPC $8200; 25 distinct samples via the $0400 directory

name: dat_spc_instruments
comment: instrument table -> SPC $0600; 6 bytes each (sample, ADSR1, ADSR2, GAIN, pitch)

name: dat_spc_curve
comment: 24-byte volume/velocity curve -> SPC $03E0

name: dat_spc_songtable
comment: song pointer table + SFX sequences -> SPC $3B00; song ptrs at SPC $3AFE + 2*id

name: dat_spc_sampledir
comment: sample directory -> SPC $0400; 80 entries of (start16, loop16)

name: mus_song_06
comment: song id $84, first song in address order

name: mus_song_02
comment: song id $80, largest song (7270 bytes to SPC $6502)
